head: c796730122cb347d25bcfdaf33647e18ba9776e8
title: Cancel at period end marks the order but the renewal query still picks it up

bugs.note: A scheduled cancellation keeps the order active and only records a cancel_at_period_end meta row. The cron query that selects active orders close to expiry for renewal invoices does not look at that row, so the client gets a renewal invoice for the period after the one they cancelled; with credit on the account it is paid from the balance and the order is renewed.
